fullDescription: Warm editorial blog-article card on a printed-paper canvas: a sticky cream glass nav, a centered serif hero, and a single deliberate article card (burgundy duotone cover with a feather motif and an oversized '07' numeral, a category+date meta row, a serif headline with a grow-on-hover underline, an excerpt, and a monogram author row) beside an editorial rail, in cream + ink + a single burgundy accent, set in Fraunces serif + Inter.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm editorial blog-article card composition ('FieldNotes — The Editorial Card') built around a single, deliberate article card on a printed-paper page. A sticky translucent cream nav sits above a centered full-bleed hero band (a tracked uppercase eyebrow, a serif headline with an italic accent, and a subhead), then the stage: a centered article card (a burgundy duotone cover with a feather motif, an oversized issue numeral, and a read-time pill; a category + date meta row; a serif headline with a grow-on-hover underline; an excerpt; a 'Read the essay' link; a hairline; and an author row with a monogram avatar + bookmark/share actions) sitting beside a deliberately-filled editorial rail (issue eyebrow, a serif pull-quote, a hairline, and an 'Also in this issue' numbered list), closed by a full-bleed ink footer. Cream + ink + a single burgundy accent, set in Fraunces serif + Inter sans on a grain-washed paper canvas.

## Estilo Visual
Build a warm editorial blog page on a paper canvas: body background #efe7da, cream surfaces #faf6ef (and a secondary cream #f4ece0 for hover fills), with a faint 'grain' wash made of a radial-gradient dot pattern (rgba(28,24,21,0.05) 1px dots on a 4px x 4px tile). Headings and strong text are near-black ink #1c1815; body and secondary text are a softer ink #4b4039. The single brand accent is burgundy: #7b2d3b (links, eyebrows, accents, primary button) and a deep #5e1f2b (hover / gradient end). Warm hairlines and rings are #e6ddd0. Load two Google fonts: Fraunces (serif, opsz 9..144, weights 400/500/600/700/900 plus italic 400/500) used for all headlines, eyebrows, the big issue numeral, the avatar monogram and the pull-quote (add a .fr-italic helper that forces Fraunces italic for accent words); and Inter (sans, weights 400-700, -webkit-font-smoothing antialiased) for nav, body, meta and UI. Smooth scroll on html. Define a custom card shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(28,24,21,0.05), 0 18px 40px -16px rgba(28,24,21,0.22), 0 2px 8px rgba(123,45,59,0.06)) for the article card. The cover image is a 'duotone': layer a 135deg linear-gradient(rgba(123,45,59,0.42), rgba(28,24,21,0.30)) over a radial-gradient(120% 120% at 18% 12%, #c98a6b 0%, #a4576b 38%, #7b2d3b 70%, #5e1f2b 100%). Accent micro-labels are 11px semibold uppercase with 0.34em letter-spacing in burgundy. Links use an 'underline-grow' effect: a 1.5px burgundy underline drawn via background-image, background-size 0 -> 100% on hover with a 0.4s ease transition. Icons are Lucide via Iconify (lucide:*).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glass nav
A sticky top header (sticky top-0 z-50) with a bottom border-line/80 (#e6ddd0) and a translucent cream backdrop (bg-cream/85 #faf6ef at 85% + backdrop-blur-md). Inside, a max-w-6xl row, items center, space-between, px-6/sm:px-8 py-4. Left: a brand lockup, an 8x8 rounded-full ink (#1c1815) circle holding a cream serif 'F' glyph, then a serif 18px semibold tracking-tight wordmark 'Field' in ink with 'Notes' in burgundy (#7b2d3b). Center: a hidden md:flex nav of 13px medium links (Essays, Craft, Archive, About) in soft-ink (#4b4039) that turn burgundy on hover, gap-9. Right: a rounded-full burgundy (#7b2d3b) 'Subscribe' button, 13px semibold cream text, px-4 py-2, with a lucide:arrow-right (14px) that nudges right on hover and a hover:bg-burgdk (#5e1f2b).

### Full-bleed hero band
A centered hero section with the grain dot wash, a bottom border-line and bg-cream, position relative overflow-hidden, with two large blurred burgundy radial blobs bleeding off the top-right and bottom-left corners (pointer-events-none, h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-burg/10 and bg-burg/[0.07], blur-3xl). Content in a max-w-6xl, px-6/sm:px-8, py-16/sm:py-20, text-center: a burgundy 11px semibold uppercase eyebrow with 0.34em tracking reading 'The Editorial Card'; an h1 in Fraunces serif, 4xl -> sm:5xl -> md:6xl, semibold, leading-[1.06], tracking-tight, max-w-[16ch], text-balance, ink, reading 'Stories that earn the' then a burgundy Fraunces-italic 'second glance.'; and a max-w-xl 15px leading-relaxed soft-ink subhead reading 'A single, deliberate article card. Cover, category, a serif headline, and the people behind the words, composed to feel printed, not posted.'

### The article card (signature component)
A cream (#faf6ef) rounded-2xl article element, max-w-[440px], overflow-hidden, ring-1 ring-line (#e6ddd0), with the custom card shadow; it is a group for hover effects. TOP: a duotone cover at aspect-[16/10], relative overflow-hidden, filled with the burgundy duotone gradient, layered with: a faint repeating-linear-gradient(115deg) cream hairline texture at 30% opacity; two large thin cream-bordered circles bleeding off the bottom-left (border-cream/20 and border-cream/15); an oversized serif '07' issue numeral (text-[120px] semibold leading-none text-cream/10) anchored bottom-right; a centered lucide:feather motif (58px, text-cream/90, soft drop-shadow); and a top-right 'read time' pill (rounded-full bg-ink/35 backdrop-blur-sm ring-1 ring-cream/20, 11px cream, a lucide:clock-3 12px icon + '6 min read'). CONTENT (px-7/sm:px-8 pt-6): a meta row (a rounded-full bg-burg/10 pill in 12px semibold uppercase tracking-wider burgundy reading 'Design Craft', a 1px line dot, and a time element with a lucide:calendar 13px icon + 'March 17, 2026' in soft-ink/80); then an h2 link in Fraunces serif 27px (sm:29px) semibold leading-[1.12] tracking-tight ink with the underline-grow effect and hover:text-burg, reading 'The quiet discipline of a card that knows when to stop.'; then a 15px leading-[1.65] soft-ink excerpt; then a 'Read the essay' link (13px semibold burgundy, inline-flex, a lucide:arrow-right 15px that translates right on hover). DIVIDER: a 1px bg-line rule. AUTHOR ROW (px-7/sm:px-8 py-5, flex items-center justify-between): left, a 10x10 rounded-full burgundy->burgdk gradient avatar with a cream serif 'MA' monogram and a ring-2 ring-cream, beside a two-line block (13px semibold ink name 'Mira Adeyemi' + 12px soft-ink/75 role 'Editorial Lead'); right, two 9x9 rounded-full ghost icon buttons (lucide:bookmark and lucide:share-2, 16px, soft-ink/60, hover:bg-creamlo hover:text-burg).

### Editorial rail (fills the wide frame)
A hidden lg:block aside, lg:pt-6, that deliberately fills the right column. Top: a burgundy 11px semibold uppercase eyebrow with 0.34em tracking reading 'Issue No. 07'. Then a Fraunces serif blockquote, 2xl, medium, leading-[1.3], tracking-tight, max-w-md, ink, with a burgundy Fraunces-italic accent: 'A good card doesn't shout. It leans in and lets the words do the rest.'. Then a short 16-unit burgundy/40 hairline (h-px w-16). Then an 11px semibold uppercase tracking-[0.22em] soft-ink/60 label 'Also in this issue', followed by a 3-item list, each item a flex items-baseline gap-3 with a small Fraunces serif burgundy/70 index ('01','02','03') and a 14px medium soft-ink underline-grow link (hover:text-burg): 'The case against the borrowed drop shadow', 'Setting a serif so it reads like a title', 'Why every layout needs one place to rest'.

### Full-bleed ink footer
A full-bleed footer with a top border-line on a bg-ink (#1c1815) text-cream band. Inside a max-w-6xl row (px-6/sm:px-8 py-8), flex-col items-center gap-4 -> sm:flex-row justify-between: left, a brand lockup (a 7x7 rounded-full cream circle with an ink serif 'F', then a serif 16px semibold 'Field' + burgundy 'Notes'); center, a 12px cream/55 line 'A small journal about making things with care. (c) 2026.'; right, three cream/70 social icon links (lucide:twitter, lucide:rss, lucide:mail, 17px) that brighten to full cream on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Editorial article card: a cream rounded-2xl card (1px warm line ring + a custom 3-part card shadow) composed of a burgundy duotone cover (feather motif, oversized '07' serif numeral, top-right read-time pill) over a content block (a category-pill + date meta row, a serif underline-grow headline, an excerpt, a 'Read the essay' link), a hairline, and an author row.

### Componente
Duotone cover: an aspect-[16/10] panel filled by layering a 135deg burgundy->ink linear-gradient over a radial peach->burgundy->deep-burgundy fill, decorated with a faint repeating diagonal hairline texture, two bleeding cream-border circles, and a huge translucent serif issue numeral.

### Componente
Monogram avatar: a 10x10 rounded-full burgundy->deep-burgundy gradient circle with a cream serif initials monogram and a 2px cream ring.

### Componente
Read-time pill: a small rounded-full bg-ink/35 backdrop-blur pill (1px cream ring) with a lucide:clock-3 icon over the cover image.

### Componente
Underline-grow link: a text link whose 1.5px burgundy underline animates from 0 to full width on hover (background-image + background-size transition), used on the card headline and the 'Also in this issue' list.

### Componente
Mega-tracked eyebrow: an 11px semibold uppercase burgundy micro-label with 0.34em letter-spacing, used for 'The Editorial Card' and 'Issue No. 07'.

### Componente
Glass sticky nav: a sticky top-0 z-50 translucent bg-cream/85 + backdrop-blur-md header with a warm line bottom hairline and a circular 'F' brand mark.

### Componente
Grain wash: a faint radial-dot background (rgba(28,24,21,0.05) 1px dots on a 4px tile) applied to the hero and card-stage bands for a printed-paper texture.

## Notas Especiais
Single-accent discipline: burgundy (#7b2d3b primary, #5e1f2b deep) is the only brand color on a warm paper canvas (body #efe7da, cream surfaces #faf6ef, secondary cream #f4ece0) with near-black ink (#1c1815) headings and soft ink (#4b4039) body, and warm line hairlines (#e6ddd0). Two typefaces by role: Fraunces serif (opsz 9..144, weights 400-900 + a real italic, via Google Fonts) carries all the editorial voice, headlines, eyebrows, the issue numeral, the monogram and the pull-quote, while Inter sans (400-700) handles nav, body, meta and UI. The whole thing is framed to feel 'printed, not posted': a grain dot wash, a duotone cover instead of a stock photo, an oversized issue numeral, and a deliberately-filled editorial rail so the wide frame never reads as empty around the single card. Icons are Lucide (lucide:*) via Iconify. Copy is human with zero em-dashes ('Stories that earn the second glance.', 'A good card doesn't shout. It leans in and lets the words do the rest.'). The article/author/issue content is sample copy so the prompt ships with no bundled assets; the reusable value is the editorial article-card composition (duotone cover + serif headline + monogram author row) and the cream/ink/burgundy print system, not the words.
